title: San Juan Island Brewing Company
specs: Award-winning craft beer focused on balance and sessionability
Family and kid friendly with a full kids menu
Dogs allowed on outdoor patio only, must be leashed and licensed

blurb: Guests can enjoy award-winning craft beer and a full menu in a relaxed, family-friendly brewery and restaurant. The brewery features a patio for outdoor seating where dogs are allowed. The brewery is a community hub with a focus on balance and sessionable beers that pair well with food.
extraNote: No reservations; seating is first come, first served · Full restaurant buyouts available for private events May through October · No outside food allowed on patio; only beer from the bar · At the brewery, 410 A Street, Friday Harbor
